name: Good_20Nov_1202
prompt: An operator assembles a phone on the workbench. The phone chassis is already on the table. In order: 1. install the camera module into the chassis, 2. install the motherboard into the chassis, 3. install the battery pack into the battery bay, 4. install the charging port module at the bottom of the chassis, 5. install the speaker module into the lower chassis cavity, 6. attach the back cover and press it down to close the phone. Flag an anomaly if any step is missing (for example the back cover is attached without the motherboard inside), or if the steps are done out of order (for example the speaker module is installed before the charging port module, or the back cover is attached before all parts are in).
